test: T1 Normal trip and door cycle
initial_condition: Startup at Floor 1, door closed and E-stop healthy.
input: Enable; request Floor 3; simulate departure, Floor 2 passage and Floor 3 arrival, then door endpoints.
expected_result: UP starts and stops at Floor 3. The door opens, dwells for 5 s and closes. REQ3 clears.
observed_result: Native checkpoints confirmed MOTOR_UP and REQ3, OPENING at Floor 3, DWELL with REQ3 cleared, CLOSING and final IDLE with RUN_EN. T1_PASS is active.
method: Native TriLOGI fixture with unchanged controller equations and timers

test: T2 Queued stops and direction reversal
initial_condition: Enabled at Floor 1 with closed door.
input: Request Floors 2 and 3. Serve both door cycles; then request Floor 1.
expected_result: Serve Floor 2 before Floor 3, preserve REQ3 through the first stop, and travel downward for the later Floor 1 request.
observed_result: Native checkpoints confirmed the intermediate stop, retained REQ3, upward continuation, downward command and completion at Floor 1. T2_PASS is active.
method: Native TriLOGI fixture with unchanged controller equations and timers

test: T3 Obstruction reopening and deliberate recovery
initial_condition: Cabin stationary at Floor 1; door cycle reaches closing.
input: Activate obstruction during closing; confirm open; try Reset while obstructed; clear obstruction, Reset and Start.
expected_result: Closing stops, alarm and buzzer latch, reopening is commanded and travel remains disabled. Reset while blocked is refused; valid Reset still requires Start.
observed_result: Native checkpoints confirmed JAM_FLT, REOPEN, DOOR_OP_CMD and BUZZER with motor and close commands off. Blocked reset was refused; corrected reset and separate Start restored the closed-door idle state. T3_PASS is active.
method: Native TriLOGI fixture with unchanged controller equations and timers

test: T4 Closing timeout reopening and recovery
initial_condition: Cabin at Floor 1; closing begins with endpoint feedback inactive.
input: Withhold DOOR_CLOSED beyond 8 s. Confirm recovery-open feedback, Reset and Start.
expected_result: Closing timeout blocks motion, latches a jam alarm and buzzer, and commands reopening. Recovery requires valid Reset and separate Start.
observed_result: Native checkpoints confirmed JAM_FLT, REOPEN and opening command after the timeout. Open feedback ended recovery opening; Reset did not enable operation; separate Start closed the door. T4_PASS is active.
method: Native TriLOGI fixture with unchanged controller equations and timers

test: T5 Emergency stop between floors and reset
input: Remove ESTOP_OK, restore it, attempt Reset between floors, then restore a known floor and perform Reset and Start.
expected_result: Movement stops immediately. Release alone and an unknown-position reset cannot restart the cabin.
observed_result: Native checkpoints confirmed ESTOP_FLT and FAULT with travel off, rejected reset between floors, and deliberate recovery at a known floor. T5_PASS is active.
method: Native TriLOGI fixture with unchanged controller equations and timers

initial_condition: Enabled cabin at Floor 1 with closed door.
input: Activate FLOOR2 while FLOOR1 remains true.
expected_result: Contradictory floor feedback latches SENSOR_FLT and blocks all actuator commands.
observed_result: Native checkpoints confirmed SENSOR_FLT and FAULT; both travel commands and both door commands were off. T6_PASS is active.
method: Native TriLOGI fixture with unchanged controller equations and timers

test: T7 Door confirmation lost during travel
initial_condition: Cabin travelling upward with closed-door feedback.
expected_result: Travel stops and a hard door fault latches; no recovery movement is attempted between floors.
observed_result: Native checkpoints confirmed DOOR_FLT and FAULT with both motor directions and opening command off. T7_PASS is active.
method: Native TriLOGI fixture with unchanged controller equations and timers

initial_condition: Cabin travelling after a Floor 3 request.
input: Withhold arrival feedback for more than 15 s.
expected_result: TRAVEL_FLT, FAULT and buzzer latch; RUN_EN and travel outputs switch off.
observed_result: Native checkpoints confirmed TRAVEL_FLT, FAULT and BUZZER with both motor directions and RUN_EN off. T8_PASS is active.
method: Native TriLOGI fixture with unchanged controller equations and timers

initial_condition: Cabin at a floor; obstruction has initiated recovery opening.
input: Withhold DOOR_OPEN for more than 8 s during recovery.
expected_result: A hard door fault stops the recovery command; the jam remains latched and travel stays disabled.
observed_result: Native checkpoints first confirmed recovery opening, then DOOR_FLT, HARD_FAULT and JAM_FLT with all motor and door commands off. T9_PASS and ALL_PASS are active.
method: Native TriLOGI fixture with unchanged controller equations and timers
